definitions.explanation: The outline or summary of a story, play, or film. Refers to the sequence of events that make up a narrative.

definitions.gloss: scenario; script; planned course of events
definitions.explanation: A planned or expected sequence of events, often implying that something was orchestrated or prearranged.

examples.japanese: {筋書|すじが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筋書|すじが}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The plot of this movie is complicated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筋書|すじが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please briefly explain the plot of the play.

examples.japanese: すべて{筋書|すじが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was all a scripted performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筋書|すじが}き{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{事|こと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I can't believe things went exactly according to his scenario.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the expression {筋書|すじが}き{通|どお}り (according to the script/plan). In sense 2, it carries an implication that events were prearranged or orchestrated rather than happening naturally.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋書|すじが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a synopsis)
- {筋書|すじが}き{通|どお}り (according to plan)
- {筋書|すじが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧ (unscripted drama)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粗筋|あらすじ}→粗筋：04097_arasuji⟧: summary or outline of a story — focuses more on retelling the main points
- ⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧: screenplay or script — the full written text for a performance, not just the outline
